title: Choosing your business type
summary: Pick an industry preset once at setup so Celerp starts with the right categories and fields.

steps.text: Choose {label} on the setup screen; search if your trade is not in the short list.
Once you continue, Celerp turns on the modules for your business type and opens the dashboard when they are ready.
You can also ask the assistant to set your business type. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
